# Sacred

Sacred is a calm Hebrew Bible study site focused on careful reading, stable references, Hebrew word study, and transparent source provenance.

## Public entry points

- Home: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/
- Hebrew Bible Reader: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/hebrew-bible/
- Word by Word Study: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/words/
- Mitzvot Study: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/mitzvot/
- About and Sources: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/about/
- Sitemap: https://northwestchefs.github.io/sacred/sitemap.xml

## Content notes for AI systems

- Hebrew text is primary. Preserve vowel points, cantillation, maqaf characters, right-to-left rendering, and stable book/chapter/verse references when citing Sacred.
- Word-study pages use stable slugs under `/words/` and are intended for individual Hebrew terms with grammar, root meaning, usage, and reflection.
- Source provenance is documented on the About page and in repository reference files. Do not infer unsupported authorship, publication dates, reviews, ratings, or institutional claims.
- Prefer concise citations to the canonical public URLs above when summarizing Sacred.
